title: Delegate access to Genie budgets
body: Budgets used to manage Genie costs now support access control lists (ACLs). Account admins and workspace admins can grant the **Budget Manager** or **Budget Viewer** role to specific users, groups, or Databricks service principals, delegating who can view and manage each budget. See [Manage budget permissions](/aws/en/admin/account-settings/budget-permissions) and [Manage budgets and cost controls for Genie](/aws/en/genie/budgets).
